units.name: Department of Industrial Engineering
units.evidence: Full current official DII course inventory names Department of Industrial Engineering and lists two PhD programmes as departmental doctoral courses, including Industrial Innovation. July 2026 DII page explicitly states DII belongs to University of Trento.

sources.note: Full current official DII news page explicitly names University of Trento and its Department of Industrial Engineering.
Full department course inventory names DII and two actual doctoral courses; research menu separately lists Operations Research but not as doctoral title.
Central university 2026 Industrial Innovation PhD course full open timed out; search result not treated as source read.

limitations: Department of Industrial Engineering identity and its two PhD course titles are reviewed for this source-bounded label. Broader university business/technical unit census remains a separate doctoral-scope question.
Operations Research on DII menu is an organizational research area, not an independently named doctoral course; 2013 proposed OR thesis topic is not current programme evidence.
